findings.summary: Dark-scheme screenshot is pixel-identical to light: white surfaces and black text remain
findings.evidence: Dark-scheme screenshot is pixel-identical to light: white surfaces and black text remain; DOM/CSS has no color-scheme or prefers-color-scheme rule.
findings.suggestedFix: Add color-scheme: light dark and theme surface/text tokens with prefers-color-scheme or light-dark().

findings.summary: Multi-page navigation changes are abrupt and DOM/CSS inspection found no @view-transition opt-in or View Transition API usage.
findings.evidence: Multi-page navigation changes are abrupt and DOM/CSS inspection found no @view-transition opt-in or View Transition API usage.
findings.suggestedFix: Opt same-origin pages into cross-document View Transitions, with reduced-motion respected.

findings.summary: The long browse and age-assurance pages have no navigation landmark, persistent header, progress indicator, or other scroll-position orientation aid.
findings.evidence: The long browse and age-assurance pages have no navigation landmark, persistent header, progress indicator, or other scroll-position orientation aid.
findings.suggestedFix: Add semantic navigation and a restrained sticky/progress affordance on long listing/article pages.

findings.summary: Target-size probe measured primary links at 12-17px high and radio/checkbox controls at 13x13px, far below a comfortable touch target.
findings.evidence: Target-size probe measured primary links at 12-17px high and radio/checkbox controls at 13x13px, far below a comfortable touch target.
findings.suggestedFix: Increase link/control hit areas to at least 44px where practical and retain visible focus styles.

findings.summary: Registration source handles invalid fields with blocking JavaScript alert() calls
findings.evidence: Registration source handles invalid fields with blocking JavaScript alert() calls; there are no inline error summaries, persistent field messages, or retry guidance.
findings.suggestedFix: Replace alert validation with inline post-interaction errors, a focusable summary and live-region announcements.

findings.summary: HAR is tiny (21,379 bytes, 9 requests) with no blocking candidates, but Lighthouse reports inefficient cache lifetime and image delivery
findings.evidence: HAR is tiny (21,379 bytes, 9 requests) with no blocking candidates, but Lighthouse reports inefficient cache lifetime and image delivery; the LCP image lacks explicit dimensions/srcset.
findings.suggestedFix: Give images dimensions/srcset, modern encodings and effective cache headers while prioritising the hero.

findings.summary: Lighthouse accessibility is 0.63 on home and 0.76 on registration: 9 home images lack alt, and username, email, password and DOB selects have no associated labels.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse accessibility is 0.63 on home and 0.76 on registration: 9 home images lack alt, and username, email, password and DOB selects have no associated labels.
findings.suggestedFix: Add html lang, semantic landmarks, useful/empty alt text as appropriate, and explicit labels for every field/select.

findings.summary: DOM probes found no main/nav/header/footer landmarks and no h1 on landing/registration
findings.evidence: DOM probes found no main/nav/header/footer landmarks and no h1 on landing/registration; Lighthouse flags missing main landmark.
findings.suggestedFix: Add main/nav landmarks and one logical h1 per page; verify keyboard order and focus-visible.

findings.summary: Footer links render at only 8pt/12px and dense browse metadata uses 10pt text, producing cramped reading and tap areas on mobile.
findings.evidence: Footer links render at only 8pt/12px and dense browse metadata uses 10pt text, producing cramped reading and tap areas on mobile.
findings.suggestedFix: Raise small footer/list text and spacing to comfortable mobile reading sizes.

findings.summary: Both pages set maximum-scale=1.0, which Lighthouse flags as restricting zoom
findings.evidence: Both pages set maximum-scale=1.0, which Lighthouse flags as restricting zoom; many measured controls are under 44px despite correct horizontal reflow.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove maximum-scale=1.0 and enlarge touch targets while preserving reflow.

findings.summary: Image audit found all 10 images without dimensions, 10 legacy-format assets, and 9 missing alt attributes
findings.evidence: Image audit found all 10 images without dimensions, 10 legacy-format assets, and 9 missing alt attributes; markup also relies heavily on layout tables and obsolete presentational attributes.
findings.suggestedFix: Modernise semantic markup and declare image dimensions/aspect ratios; remove presentational attributes/tables.

findings.summary: Lighthouse reports the landing page is ineligible for back/forward cache restoration
findings.evidence: Lighthouse reports the landing page is ineligible for back/forward cache restoration; source also contains legacy browser-prefixed gradients and presentational markup.
findings.suggestedFix: Investigate and remove the BFCache blocker and retire obsolete CSS/HTML patterns.

findings.summary: Landing has a descriptive title but no meta description
findings.evidence: Landing has a descriptive title but no meta description; login title is empty and other titles are generic (register, age-assurance).
findings.suggestedFix: Give every template a unique descriptive title and meta description.

findings.summary: No canonical link is present and /sitemap.xml returns an HTML File not found body with status-like content rather than a sitemap.
findings.evidence: No canonical link is present and /sitemap.xml returns an HTML File not found body with status-like content rather than a sitemap.
findings.suggestedFix: Publish a valid sitemap.xml, canonical links and consistent status/indexing signals.

findings.summary: Landing and age-assurance pages expose no JSON-LD and no Open Graph/social-preview metadata despite representing an organization/service and substantive policy content.
findings.evidence: Landing and age-assurance pages expose no JSON-LD and no Open Graph/social-preview metadata despite representing an organization/service and substantive policy content.
findings.suggestedFix: Add accurate Open Graph metadata and relevant JSON-LD for the service and content pages.

findings.summary: HTTPS is used, but CSP, HSTS and nosniff are absent
findings.evidence: HTTPS is used, but CSP, HSTS and nosniff are absent; 7 cookies are insecure, including ASP.NET_SessionId without Secure, and several are SameSite=None.
findings.suggestedFix: Set Secure, HttpOnly where appropriate, and Lax/Strict cookies; deploy HSTS, CSP and nosniff.

findings.summary: No permission prompt fires on load, but authentication exposes only username/password and no passkey/WebAuthn option
findings.evidence: No permission prompt fires on load, but authentication exposes only username/password and no passkey/WebAuthn option; registration defaults Remember my login on.
findings.suggestedFix: Offer passkey/WebAuthn sign-in and make persistent login an explicit user choice.

findings.summary: Headers probe finds no HSTS, CSP/frame-ancestors, Referrer-Policy or Permissions-Policy
findings.evidence: Headers probe finds no HSTS, CSP/frame-ancestors, Referrer-Policy or Permissions-Policy; only X-Frame-Options SAMEORIGIN is present.
findings.suggestedFix: Deploy CSP/frame-ancestors, HSTS, Referrer-Policy and a least-privilege Permissions-Policy.

findings.summary: This mobile dating service has no web app manifest or service worker/offline fallback signal despite app-like repeat use.
findings.evidence: This mobile dating service has no web app manifest or service worker/offline fallback signal despite app-like repeat use.
findings.suggestedFix: For this repeat-use mobile service, add a manifest and a minimal offline/retry fallback.

findings.summary: Requesting /sitemap.xml returns a File not found message in an otherwise 200-looking HTML response with only a home link
findings.evidence: Requesting /sitemap.xml returns a File not found message in an otherwise 200-looking HTML response with only a home link; no intentional 404 status/recovery shell is exposed.
findings.suggestedFix: Return correct HTTP error statuses and provide useful, navigable recovery pages.

findings.summary: All audited documents have an empty html lang and no dir
findings.evidence: All audited documents have an empty html lang and no dir; Lighthouse flags html-has-lang, and CSS uses physical left/right properties.
findings.suggestedFix: Set correct lang/dir and migrate physical CSS properties to logical inline/block properties.

findings.summary: Registration preselects Remember my login and bundles age confirmation with agreement to site rules
findings.evidence: Registration preselects Remember my login and bundles age confirmation with agreement to site rules; these defaults are not maximally privacy-preserving or granular.
findings.suggestedFix: Default persistent login off and separate age attestation from terms acceptance.

findings.evidence: Required-field validation uses sequential alert() dialogs and focus jumps instead of post-interaction inline messages, aria-invalid and an accessible error summary.
findings.suggestedFix: Use constraint validation plus :user-invalid, aria-invalid and accessible inline feedback after interaction.

findings.evidence: Login username/password lack standard autocomplete tokens; registration email has none and username explicitly disables autocomplete.
findings.suggestedFix: Add correct username/current-password/email/new-password autocomplete tokens.
